scripts.smoke:tui: npm run docker:up:stack && npm run smoke:health && npm run devices:seed && npm run tui && npm run docker:down:stack
scripts.smoke:tui:prep: npm run docker:up:stack && npm run smoke:health && npm run devices:seed
scripts.setup: python -m venv --clear .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements/dev.txt && .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/setup_demo_env.py
scripts.setup:prod: python -m venv --clear .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements/base.txt && .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/setup_demo_env.py
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.check:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format && npm run typecheck
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run test
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run format && npm run typecheck && npm run test:cov
